title: Remote-proxy rebase witness on the background delta path (baseline, sparse messages)
outcome: Remote-proxy rebase witness on the background delta path (baseline, sparse messages)
acceptance: A test persists a remote proxy's peer window through the delta path with a PersistTranscriptBaseline (serialize_persisted_session_since with Some(baseline), or persist_delta_via_cache), applies a tail rebase after a peer insert before the window, and shows that the relocated peer id is in the sparse messages list, is released from its out-of-window row, and that the durable rows match upstream order with the other omitted rows kept
The test passes on the code that contains the relocated-peer-identity release, and is verified by a host-recorded focused run
